summary: RideNow Group, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry on September 25, 2026 into a $220 million senior secured term loan credit agreement with affiliates of Centerbridge Partners as lenders and Alter Domus as administrative and collateral agent. Proceeds refinanced in full and terminated the prior August 31, 2021 term loan facility administered by Oaktree Fund Administration. The new loans mature September 25, 2031, are subsidiary-guaranteed and secured by a first-priority lien on substantially all assets, excluding floor-plan inventory liens. Interest is Base Rate plus 7.375% or Adjusted Term SOFR (3.00% floor) plus 8.375%, with a 24-month non-call make-whole. This is a routine refinancing, not a special situation; watch leverage and spread costs.
